job.title: Head of Customer Experience
job.description:
Location: Dumfriesshire, Scotland
Salary: Up to £65,000 + bonus and benefits


The Animal People Recruitment Company is working in partnership with a leading farming and livestock business with a well-established presence across Scotland. As the business continues to develop its commercial operations, we are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader to take ownership of its Customer Experience function.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys a challenge, understands what makes a business commercially successful and has the leadership capability to bring people, processes and performance together.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Commercial Director, you will take responsibility for developing and leading a sizeable customer-facing function, bringing together customer services, customer feedback and operational insight under one cohesive strategy.

You'll be leading a team of 15+ colleagues across a variety of disciplines, with responsibility for creating the structure, direction and framework needed to support the business as it continues to grow.

This isn't simply about maintaining customer service standards. It's about challenging existing processes, identifying opportunities for improvement and creating a more effective, commercially aligned operation that delivers measurable results.

You'll have the opportunity to influence how the function operates, how performance is measured and how people are developed, while working closely with senior stakeholders across the wider business.

What will you be responsible for?

  • Developing and implementing a clear Customer Experience strategy, aligned with the wider commercial objectives of the business.
  • Leading, motivating and developing a multi-disciplinary team, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and high performance.
  • Establishing effective performance frameworks, KPIs and reporting structures to measure service delivery, customer satisfaction and commercial impact.
  • Using data, customer feedback and business insight to identify trends, challenge existing practices and drive meaningful improvements.
  • Reviewing processes and operational structures to improve efficiency, consistency, order accuracy and the overall customer journey.
  • Building strong working relationships across Sales, Operations, Finance and other key business functions.
  • Developing management capability within the team, providing direction, coaching and support to ensure people have the tools and motivation to succeed.
  • Driving continuous improvement and embedding positive change across the function.
  • Acting as a key voice for the customer within the senior leadership environment, translating insight into practical business recommendations.

What are we looking for?

We are interested in speaking with established managers and leaders who can demonstrate strong commercial awareness, sound business judgement and the ability to bring people together to deliver results.
You might currently be working in Sales Management, Commercial Operations, Customer Experience or a similar senior leadership position. What matters most is your ability to understand the bigger commercial picture while remaining close enough to the detail to make things happen.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Proven experience leading and developing sizeable teams, ideally across multiple functions or disciplines.
  • A strong commercial background, with the ability to understand business performance, identify opportunities and translate objectives into practical action.
  • Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, with confidence using data and insight to influence business decisions.
  • Experience implementing performance management frameworks, KPIs, processes and structures that improve productivity and accountability.
  • The ability to challenge existing ways of working constructively and lead people through change.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to influence at senior leadership level.
  • A methodical, organised and professional approach, with the resilience to manage competing priorities and demanding deadlines.
  • A positive, energetic and hands-on leadership style, leading by example and setting high standards for work ethic and professionalism.

Just as importantly, you'll be someone who isn't afraid of a challenging environment. You'll need to be adaptable, resilient and comfortable working with a range of strong personalities and opinions, bringing people with you and maintaining focus on the bigger business objectives.

The Working Environment

 This is a highly visible leadership position, and being present within the business is an important part of its success.

The role is based at the company's Birkhill office, with a mandatory five-day working week on site. There is no hybrid working arrangement or flexible-hours option.
You will need to travel once a month to the sister site at Turiff.

The nature of the operation means that the team needs accessible, visible leadership, particularly during busy periods when decisions, support and collaboration are essential.

For the right person, this offers the opportunity to become genuinely embedded in the business, build strong relationships and have a direct influence on how the function develops.

What's on Offer?

  • Basic salary of up to £65,000, depending on experience.
  • Company performance bonus.
  • Car allowance.
  • Contributory pension scheme.
  • Private healthcare programme.
  • Additional company benefits.

Most importantly, this is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant business function, influence its future direction and play an important part in the continued commercial development of an established Scottish business.

Who might this suit?

Perhaps you're an experienced Sales Manager who has enjoyed leading teams and delivering commercial results but is now looking for an opportunity away from a field-based sales position.

Perhaps you're already leading a customer-facing or commercial operations team and want greater ownership, influence and the opportunity to shape a function rather than simply manage its day-to-day activity.

If you're commercially astute, enjoy developing people and have the drive to make things better, we'd love to hear from you.

Interested in finding out more?

For a confidential conversation, please register your interest by applying here.

job.title: Senior Logistics Coordinator
job.description:
Senior Logistics Coordinator | Hertfordshire | Onsite
£32,000–£40,000 DOE | Full Time

The Animal People Recruitment Company are proud to be exclusively partnering with a fast-growing pet care brand to recruit a Senior Logistics Coordinator during an exciting period of growth and international expansion.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with experience in logistics, shipping, exports, supply chain or order fulfilment who enjoys being hands-on, solving problems and keeping a busy operation running smoothly.

The business has experienced significant growth across UK and international markets and is looking for someone who can take ownership of its day-to-day logistics activities, including order processing, shipping, stock movements and Amazon FBA replenishment.

This isn't a large corporate logistics environment. You'll be joining a growing consumer products business where you'll work closely with leadership, warehouse, manufacturing and ecommerce teams, making a genuine difference to how products move through the business.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on, office-based position where you'll take responsibility for coordinating the daily logistics operation and ensuring orders and shipments are processed accurately and efficiently.

From processing customer orders and booking shipments to preparing export documentation, monitoring stock and resolving delivery queries, you'll play an important role in keeping products moving across multiple sales channels.

We're particularly interested in experienced Logistics, Export, Supply Chain or Operations Coordinators who are confident working with systems, highly organised and ready to take greater ownership within a growing business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process customer orders accurately and efficiently using internal order management and inventory systems.
  • Book and coordinate UK and international shipments, working closely with couriers, freight forwarders and logistics partners.
  • Prepare and check shipping documentation, including commercial invoices, customs paperwork and certificates of origin.
  • Coordinate Amazon FBA replenishment across UK and EU markets.
  • Manage and monitor stock movements across warehouse, ecommerce and fulfilment channels.
  • Maintain accurate records across logistics, stock and order management systems.
  • Work closely with warehouse supervisors, production and customer service teams to coordinate daily fulfilment priorities.
  • Monitor shipments, investigate delivery issues and resolve operational queries.
  • Support stock forecasting, inventory accuracy and replenishment planning.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is organised, confident with technology and enjoys taking ownership of the detail.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Experience in logistics, shipping, order processing, supply chain, fulfilment or operational coordination.
  • Strong computer literacy, including confident use of Excel, spreadsheets and business systems.
  • Experience using ERP, inventory management, order processing or shipping systems.
  • Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to process information accurately and efficiently.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • A proactive, practical approach to solving problems and keeping operations moving.
  • Clear communication skills and confidence working with different departments and external partners.
  • A willingness to get involved in the day-to-day operational tasks rather than simply overseeing them.

Experience with international shipping, customs documentation, Amazon FBA, ecommerce fulfilment or Unleashed would be advantageous.

Who Could This Role Suit? You might currently be working as a:

  • Logistics Manager
  • Senior Logistics Coordinator
  • Logistics Coordinator
  • Export or Shipping Coordinator
  • Supply Chain Coordinator
  • Senior Order Processing Coordinator
  • Inventory or Stock Controller
  • Ecommerce Fulfilment Coordinator
  • Operations Coordinator

You could be working in pet products, food and beverage, beauty, cosmetics, FMCG, manufacturing, wholesale or another product-led business.

What matters most is your ability to work confidently with systems, manage operational detail and take ownership of getting things done.

Why Join? This is an exciting opportunity to join an ambitious pet care business where your contribution will be recognised and your ideas welcomed.

You'll work closely with the leadership team, gain exposure to UK and international operations and have the opportunity to help shape and improve logistics processes as the business continues to grow.

For someone with the right skills and attitude, there's real scope to develop alongside the business.

If you're looking for a hands-on opportunity where you can make a genuine difference within the pet industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV. We look forward to hearing from you!

job.title: National Account Manager
job.description:
National Account Manager
Home and field based, UK
£50,000 to £55,000 + bonus, company car or car allowance and private healthcare

Want to help bring some of the world's most exciting pet brands to UK retailers?

We are recruiting for a fast-growing pet brand development and distribution business with an ambitious vision for the UK market.

The business partners with innovative international brands, helping them launch, grow and succeed across UK retail. With exciting new products entering the market and an established portfolio of national customers, they are now looking for a commercially ambitious National Account Manager to join the journey.

This is a brilliant next move for a talented Key Account Manager, National Account Executive or Junior NAM who is ready for more ownership, bigger customer conversations and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

You will inherit established relationships with leading specialist pet retailers, so you will not be starting with a blank sheet of paper. Your role will be to get closer to those customers, uncover new opportunities and help brilliant brands secure stronger listings, greater visibility and sustainable growth.

You will be part of a small, entrepreneurial team backed by a major global organisation. That means plenty of pace, freedom and access to decision-makers, alongside the support and infrastructure needed to deliver.

What will you be doing?

  • Building trusted relationships with leading pet retail customers
  • Developing existing accounts and identifying new growth opportunities
  • Helping secure new listings, promotions and range extensions
  • Bringing new international brands and products to life for UK buyers
  • Creating customer plans that deliver sustainable sales growth
  • Supporting commercial negotiations and trading discussions
  • Using sales and customer insight to spot opportunities
  • Working closely with marketing, supply chain and customer service
  • Attending customer meetings, trade shows and pet industry events

Your initial focus will be specialist pet retail, with the opportunity to broaden your experience across garden centres, e-commerce and wider retail as both you and the business develop.

Is this you?
You might currently be a Key Account Manager, Junior National Account Manager, National Account Executive, Regional Account Manager or a commercially strong Business Development Manager ready for your next step.

Pet industry experience would be a real advantage, but it is not essential. We would also love to hear from people with experience in FMCG, food and drink, consumer goods or another branded product environment.

You will bring...

  • Experience managing and developing commercial customers
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills
  • Good commercial awareness and an understanding of account performance
  • Exposure to promotions, negotiations or customer planning
  • Confidence presenting products, ideas and opportunities
  • The initiative to manage your own priorities and turn ideas into action
  • A collaborative, grounded and solutions-focused approach
  • A full UK driving licence

The right person will be smart, hungry and humble. You will be ambitious and keen to progress, but equally comfortable listening, learning and working as part of a close-knit team.

What is on offer?

  • £50,000 to £55,000 base salary
  • 20% bonus for achieving agreed individual and team targets
  • Bonus increasing to 30% when stretch targets are achieved
  • Potential bonus earnings of up to £16,500
  • Potential total annual cash earnings of up to £71,500
  • Company car or car allowance
  • Private healthcare
  • Pension contribution
  • 25 days' holiday
  • Home and field-based working
  • Direct access to an experienced and supportive leadership team
  • Genuine opportunities to develop as the business continues to grow

This is your chance to join an ambitious business early in its growth, work with genuinely exciting pet brands and see the direct impact of your ideas and relationships.

If you are ready for a role with energy, opportunity and plenty of room to grow, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact The Animal People Recruitment Company for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
Finance Manager – Number-One Finance Role
Stevenage, Hertfordshire
£55,000–£60,000 depending on experience
Permanent | Full time

Predominantly office-based, with the option to work from home one day per week following probation.

The Animal People Recruitment Company is partnering with an ambitious, owner-managed consumer-products business to appoint a hands-on Finance Manager.

Operating across the pet-care and wider consumer-products markets, the group develops, manufactures and distributes a growing portfolio of products across the UK and internationally.

This appointment will bring full-time finance leadership into the business. You will become the number-one finance person across four associated trading and property entities, reporting directly to the Managing Director and leading an established finance team.

This is much broader than a traditional management accounts position. You will take ownership of financial control, reporting, cash flow, forecasting and commercial insight, helping the Managing Director understand performance, identify risks early and make confident decisions.

The opportunity

As Finance Manager, you will:

  • Lead the day-to-day finance function across four group entities
  • Own the monthly management accounts across P&L, balance sheet and cash flow
  • Provide clear commentary on performance, risks and opportunities
  • Build and maintain a robust rolling 12-week cash-flow forecast
  • Proactively manage liquidity, working capital and funding requirements
  • Maintain control over debtors, creditors, stock, intercompany and loan balances
  • Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, variance analysis and scenario planning
  • Analyse profitability across products, customers, suppliers and sales channels
  • Work with operations and supply chain to improve stock management, product costing and gross margins
  • Support pricing, promotions, supplier negotiations and investment decisions
  • Strengthen financial controls, reporting tools, systems and processes
  • Coordinate tax and statutory compliance with external advisers
  • Lead, support and develop the existing finance team
  • Act as a trusted financial partner to the Managing Director

About you

You will already have held broad responsibility within a finance function and personally owned management accounts, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow and working-capital management.

You may currently be working as a Finance Manager or Financial Controller within an owner-managed SME, manufacturing business or stock-led organisation.

You will bring:

  • Proven ownership of management accounts, budgeting and forecasting
  • Strong practical cash-flow and working-capital management experience
  • Experience of stock, inventory, product costing and gross-margin analysis
  • The ability to translate financial information into clear commercial recommendations
  • Experience leading and developing a small finance team
  • Confidence working directly with an MD, founder or business owner
  • A hands-on approach and willingness to work within the detail
  • Strong Excel and financial systems capability
  • The confidence to improve processes and constructively challenge existing thinking
  • A collaborative, approachable and commercially curious style

Experience within manufacturing, FMCG, consumer goods, pet care, cosmetics, wholesale, distribution, e-commerce, import/export or another stock-led environment would be particularly valuable.

An ACCA, CIMA or ACA qualification would be advantageous. However, the business is equally open to part-qualified or qualified-by-experience candidates who can demonstrate the required breadth, leadership and real-world commercial experience.

What success will look like

During your first six months, you will have:

  • Established reliable and timely monthly reporting
  • Embedded a robust rolling cash-flow forecast
  • Improved visibility over stock, margins and working capital
  • Strengthened key financial controls and processes
  • Created clear priorities and accountability across the finance team
  • Built a trusted and effective working relationship with the Managing Director

Why consider this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to become genuinely influential within an entrepreneurial business where finance will play a central role in its next stage of development.

You do not need previous pet-sector experience, but you should be interested in the products, customers and purpose behind a growing pet-care business.
This is a highly collaborative position at the centre of the organisation. You must therefore be able to work from the Stevenage office for at least four days each week.

If you are an experienced, hands-on finance professional looking for greater ownership, commercial influence and the opportunity to shape a growing business, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Katie Fletcher at The Animal People Recruitment Company for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Sales Support Executive
job.description:
Sales Support Executive
Remote (UK) | £30,000–£32,000 (pro rata) | 4 or 5 days per week | Occasional international travel opportunities

Love animals, enjoy keeping things organised and want a role where you can make a real difference? This could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for.
We’re partnering with a growing, internationally recognised pet treats business to find a Sales Support Executive who loves variety, takes pride in the detail and wants to be part of a small team doing exciting things.

This isn’t a hard-selling role. It’s about being the person who helps everything run smoothly behind the scenes, from customer orders and retailer information to new products and occasional international trade shows. You’ll have the autonomy to work from home, the support of a close-knit team and the chance to see the impact of your work.

What you’ll be doing

  • Keeping customer orders moving: processing orders, preparing invoices and supporting purchase orders and pro forma documentation.
  • Working with customers, suppliers and manufacturing partners to track orders, deliveries and shipping paperwork.
  • Helping retail relationships run smoothly by maintaining product information, new line forms, pricing, barcodes and specifications.
  • Keeping spreadsheets, shared files and customer portals accurate, organised and up to date.
  • Pitching in with wider projects, including occasional social media content support.
  • Occasionally helping prepare for, organise and attend trade shows in the UK and overseas, with potential opportunities across Europe, the US and Asia.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in sales support, administration, customer service, order processing or a similarly organised, customer-facing role.
  • Confidence using Excel and Microsoft Office, with excellent attention to detail and a willingness to learn new systems.
  • Someone proactive and reliable who can prioritise, take ownership and work independently without losing the team spirit.
  • A positive, curious person who enjoys variety, communicates well and isn’t afraid to get stuck in.
  • A genuine interest in animals and enthusiasm for the pet sector. Previous pet industry experience is welcome, but not essential.
  • Willingness to attend occasional UK and international trade shows as required.

Why this role stands out

  • Flexible working: choose a four- or five-day working week, with remote working across the UK.
  • £30,000–£32,000 per annum full-time equivalent (pro rata for four days).
  • Join a growing pet brand with international customers, new products in development and a genuinely hands-on culture.
  • Opportunities for occasional travel to support UK and international trade shows.
  • A small, supportive team where your ideas, initiative and contribution will be noticed.

The practical details

This is a UK remote role with monthly team meet-ups in Knutsford, Cheshire, and occasional travel to trade shows when required. The working pattern can be four or five days per week.

Interested?

If you’re an organised, enthusiastic person who loves animals and wants to grow with an ambitious business, we’d love to hear from you. Apply with your CV through The Animal People Recruitment Company. You don’t need to tick every box we’re just as interested in your attitude and potential as your experience.

job.title: Business Ops Coordinator
job.description:
Business Operations Coordinator
Manayunk, Philadelphia, PA | On-site, five days per week
Reports to the Operations Manager

The Animal People Recruitment Company is recruiting a Business Operations Coordinator on behalf of our client, a fast-growing US pet products business with an established presence in retail and e-commerce.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys keeping things moving, from raising purchase orders and coordinating factory schedules to tracking shipments and setting up new products with retailers. As our client expands its product range and distribution network, you'll help make sure products move smoothly from manufacturing through to final delivery.

You'll work directly with factories, suppliers, warehouses, freight partners and colleagues across Operations, Sales, Marketing and Finance. It's a broad role with room to take ownership, build your supply chain experience and improve how the team works.

What you'll do
Purchasing and production

  • Create, track and follow up on purchase orders for components and finished goods.
  • Coordinate with factories, suppliers and internal teams to keep production on schedule and products available when needed.
  • Investigate discrepancies involving orders, deliveries, inventory and invoices with suppliers and warehouse partners.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing, production and receiving records.

Logistics and transportation

  • Coordinate domestic and international shipments, including less-than-truckload (LTL), full truckload (FTL) and freight forwarding.
  • Work with carriers, freight brokers and warehouses to track shipments and resolve delivery issues.
  • Maintain retailer routing guides and manage transportation requests through customer portals.
  • Identify ways to make shipping processes more efficient.

Retailer operations and product compliance

  • Set up new items in retailer systems and maintain accurate product catalog information.
  • Use retailer portals to manage orders, shipments and documentation.
  • Coordinate product compliance testing and quality control activities.
  • Track fill rates and vendor compliance requirements, and help investigate retailer chargebacks.

New products and process improvement

  • Work across Operations, Sales, Marketing and Finance to support product launches and other business initiatives.
  • Spot recurring problems and improve the processes behind them, using AI and other tools where they can help.
  • Contribute to special projects and take part in occasional factory and supplier visits.

What you'll bring

  • An associate or bachelor's degree in business administration, operations management, supply chain management or a related field.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines while keeping records accurate.
  • Clear communication and the confidence to work directly with colleagues, suppliers and logistics partners.
  • A practical approach to problem-solving and the initiative to follow an issue through to resolution.
  • The ability to take ownership of your work and adapt as priorities change.

Experience in purchasing, order management, customer or sales operations, or supply chain would be helpful. Our client would also welcome experience in pet products, consumer goods, manufacturing or e-commerce. Familiarity with freight coordination, product item setup, retailer portals or systems such as NetSuite, Shopify, EDI, Power BI, ERP, OMS or WMS would be an advantage.

Location and travel
This role is based in our client's Manayunk office five days per week. You'll need to live within commuting distance. The position may involve occasional travel, including overnight or multiday visits, and occasional participation in local community events or volunteering.

Why join our client?
You'll join a collaborative, dog-loving team and gain experience across purchasing, logistics and retailer operations in a growing US pet business. You'll see how your work affects everything from getting a new product ready for launch to getting it onto a retailer's shelves.

If this sounds like the kind of role you'd enjoy, apply with your résumé. The Animal People Recruitment Company is managing the search on behalf of our client.

job.title: Vice President Operations
job.description:
Vice President of Operations
Philadelphia, PA
Reports to the Chief Operating Officer

The Animal People Recruitment Company is recruiting a Vice President of Operations on behalf of our client, a fast-growing US pet products business with an established presence in retail and e-commerce.

As our client expands its product range, customer base and distribution network, you’ll lead end-to-end US operations and supply chain. Working directly with the COO and executive team, you’ll set the operations strategy, develop the team and put the systems and processes in place to support higher volumes and wider distribution.

This is a hands-on leadership role with scope to shape how the business operates. You’ll work with international manufacturing partners, improve inventory and delivery performance, and make decisions that balance cost, product quality and customer service.

What you’ll do Operations strategy and team leadership

  • Set the operations strategy and turn it into annual operating plans, budgets and investment priorities.
  • Lead and develop the Operations team, including its managers, with clear responsibilities and opportunities for progression.
  • Establish operational KPIs and report on performance, costs and priorities to the executive team.

Supply chain and international manufacturing

  • Oversee demand and supply planning, purchasing, production, quality, logistics and fulfillment.
  • Lead relationships with international contract manufacturers and suppliers, including capacity planning, commercial negotiations and service agreements.
  • Own Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), connecting sales forecasts with inventory, production and purchasing decisions.
  • Reduce supply chain risk through dual sourcing and business continuity planning. Coordinate operational readiness for new product launches.

Logistics and distribution

  • Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, freight forwarding, customs, import compliance, warehousing and third-party logistics partners.
  • Manage fulfillment across retail, distributor and e-commerce channels, including Amazon and major retailers.
  • Improve delivery performance and inventory availability while managing retailer requirements such as EDI, routing guides and chargebacks.

Financial performance and systems

  • Own operational costs and working capital, including cost of goods sold (COGS), landed costs, freight spend and inventory. Balance stock availability with turnover and aged inventory.
  • Develop budgets and forecasts, and identify ways to improve margins while maintaining product quality and service.
  • Improve how the business uses ERP, planning, warehouse and reporting tools, including NetSuite and Power BI. Identify where automation and AI can improve planning, reporting or day-to-day operations.

What you’ll bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations management, supply chain management, engineering or a related field.
  • At least eight years of progressive operations and supply chain experience, including at least three years at director level or above.
  • Experience leading end-to-end operations and supply chain in a consumer products business, including international contract manufacturing, overseas suppliers and imports.
  • A track record of building and developing teams, including managers.
  • Strong financial judgment and experience managing budgets, COGS, landed costs and working capital, with a clear understanding of how operational decisions affect the P&L.
  • Experience supporting retail and e-commerce distribution, including retailer compliance, EDI, routing guides and chargebacks.
  • Experience with ERP systems, ideally NetSuite, and the ability to use operational KPIs to make decisions.
  • The ability to set direction, negotiate with suppliers and get into the detail when an operational issue needs your attention.

Experience in pet products or scaling operations in a growing, founder-led or midsize business would be an advantage. Our client would also welcome familiarity with Power BI, Shopify, warehouse management or supply chain planning tools, as well as experience with international trade programs, tariff mitigation, customs compliance, automation or AI. An MBA, APICS/ASCM certification such as CPIM or CSCP, or Lean Six Sigma training would be helpful.

Location and travel
You’ll need to live within commuting distance of Philadelphia, PA. The role involves approximately 10–25% travel, including overnight and international visits to manufacturing partners. Our client also asks for occasional participation in local community events or volunteering.

Why join our client?
You’ll work directly with the COO, CEO and executive team and have a say in how the company builds its team, systems and distribution capabilities as it grows. You’ll join a collaborative, dog-loving business where your decisions will influence how reliably products reach retailers and pet owners.

If you’ve led operations in a consumer products business and would like to shape the next stage of growth for an established US pet brand, apply with your résumé. The Animal People Recruitment Company is managing the search on behalf of our client.

job.title: Territory Manager - South East
job.description:

We are a fast-growing startup on a mission to help veterinary clinics across the UK operate more sustainably. Our innovative solution supports practices in reducing environmental impact and reduces clinical staff exposure to harmful waste anaesthetic gases.

Role Overview

This is a very exciting opportunity at a pivotal time in the company journey. You will help drive the success in our core UK veterinary market. With this responsibility will bring a tremendous opportunity to build excellent experience and enjoy career defining success.

We are seeking an ambitious and motivated Territory Managers to drive growth within the UK veterinary sector. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, enjoys building relationships from the ground up, and is passionate about sustainability.

You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, engaging veterinary clinics, managing the sales cycle end-to-end, and building strong engagement and trust with our customers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, prospect, and engage veterinary clinics across your territory and the wider UK as necessary
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline from initial outreach to close
  • Conduct product demonstrations and presentations (in-person and virtual)
  • Understand clinic operations and tailor solutions to customer needs
  • Develop long-term relationships with practice owners, managers, and clinical teams
  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets
  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM system
  • Gather market and customer feedback to inform product evolution and refine commercialisation strategy
  • Represent the company at veterinary events, conferences, and trade shows


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in B2B sales (veterinary sector preferred)
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently in a startup environment
  • Comfortable with outbound sales and consultative selling
  • Passion for sustainability and positive environmental impact
  • Willingness to travel within territory and further afield if necessary (Head office in the South West and industry events)
  • Full right to work in the United Kingdom

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to veterinary clinics
  • Familiarity with sustainability, waste reduction, or environmental compliance solutions
  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or high-growth company

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary (up to £40K) with performance-based commission
  • Car allowance
  • Share options
  • Opportunity to join an early-stage company and shape its growth
  • Meaningful work with real environmental impact
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Career progression as the company scales

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Location
Head office: South West, UK (Hybrid working)

About Us
We are a fast-growing startup on a mission to help veterinary clinics across the UK operate more sustainably. Our innovative solution supports practices in reducing environmental impact and reduces clinical staff exposure to harmful waste anaesthetic gases.

Role Overview
This is a very exciting cross-functional role at a pivotal time in the company journey. This role will be responsible for driving success in our core UK veterinary market. With this responsibility will bring a tremendous opportunity to build excellent experience and enjoy career defining success.
The role will act as the central point of coordination between sales, operations, product development, customer support, finance, marketing, and external partners. The Product Manager will own the veterinary market strategy and execution, ensuring that commercial objectives are achieved while delivering exceptional service delivery and value to veterinary customers.
The Product Manager is responsible for the commercial success, operational performance, and ongoing development of the company's anaesthetic gas capture device and associated service offering within the UK veterinary market.
The successful candidate will possess well-developed commerciality to drive market growth while ensuring the product and service continue to evolve in response to customer needs, playing a core role in the success of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Management

  • Develop and execute the UK veterinary market strategy.
  • Own the commercial performance of the veterinary product portfolio.
  • Identify market opportunities, customer needs and competitive threats.
  • Develop pricing strategies and commercial propositions.
  • Monitor market trends, wider competing technologies and customer feedback to inform business decisions.
  • Build relationships with key veterinary groups, distributors and strategic partners.
  • Support the development of business cases for new initiatives and associated investment of resources.
  • Develop range of commercial KPIs for veterinary channel


Sales Support

  • Work closely with the sales team to develop and deliver sales strategies.
  • Create sales tools, product positioning and value propositions.
  • Support key customer meetings and commercial negotiations where appropriate.
  • Deliver product training for sales teams and distribution partners.
  • Monitor sales performance and implement actions to improve conversion and growth.
  • Support customer acquisition and retention initiatives.


Product Management and Development

  • Own the product roadmap for the veterinary market.
  • Gather customer insights and translate them into product improvements.
  • Coordinate product development activities with engineering and research teams.
  • Prioritise enhancements based on commercial value, customer impact and technical feasibility.
  • Liaise with regulatory colleagues to ensure the product remains compliant with relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Manage product launches, updates and lifecycle planning.


Operational Management

  • Liaise with operational colleagues to support the veterinary business.
  • Work with operations and engineering teams to ensure reliable product and service availability.
  • Monitor service delivery performance and customer satisfaction, and as a result take steps to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
  • Develop scalable processes to support business growth.
  • Identify operational risks and implement mitigation plans.


Financial Performance

  • Own revenue, profitability and growth targets for the veterinary market, developing improvement initiatives where necessary.
  • Develop annual budgets and sales forecasts, and feed in to product and service supply planning.
  • Monitor commercial and financial performance against plan and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
  • Produce regular performance reports and business updates with action plan to build on success and remedy shortfalls.


Marketing

  • Work with marketing colleagues to develop campaigns that support business growth.
  • Ensure consistent messaging and positioning across all channels.
  • Support exhibitions, conferences and veterinary events.
  • Develop educational content and customer communications.
  • Build customer advocacy and feedback through customer case studies and testimonials.


Customer Experience

  • Resolve complex customer issues through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Monitor and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.


What We’re Looking For

Essential Experience

  • Experience in the veterinary sector, possibly already in product or some form of commercial management, but above all demonstrating well-developed commerciality.
  • Proven ability of cross functional working across the business, including experience working with sales teams and customers.
  • Commercial experience with technical or medical products delivering revenue and profitability targets.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Financial planning and budgeting experience.
  • Excellent organisational and project management skills.


Desirable Experience

  • Experience with environmentally focused technologies or sustainability solutions, or demonstrable personal drive for a sustainable planet.
  • Knowledge of anaesthesia, operating theatre equipment or gas management systems.
  • Experience managing regulated products.
  • Experience working with distributors and channel partners.


Skills & Personal Attributes

  • Commercially minded with an entrepreneurial approach.
  • Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Passionate about innovation, sustainability and improving environmental outcomes within veterinary practice.
  • Able to make decisions even when analysis will only take you so far.
  • Collaborative and effective at building relationships through great communication and negotiation.
  • Curious and customer-focused, with a passion for understanding market needs.
  • Proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to manage ambiguity.
  • Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.


What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary with performance-based commission
  • Share Options
  • Opportunity to join an early-stage company and shape its growth
  • Meaningful work with real environmental impact
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Career progression as the company scales

job.title: Territory Manager - North
job.description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing startup on a mission to help veterinary clinics across the UK operate more sustainably. Our innovative solution supports practices in reducing environmental impact and reduces clinical staff exposure to harmful waste anaesthetic gases.

Role Overview

This is a very exciting opportunity at a pivotal time in the company journey. You will help drive the success in our core UK veterinary market. With this responsibility will bring a tremendous opportunity to build excellent experience and enjoy career defining success.

We are seeking an ambitious and motivated Territory Managers to drive growth within the UK veterinary sector. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment, enjoys building relationships from the ground up, and is passionate about sustainability.

You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, engaging veterinary clinics, managing the sales cycle end-to-end, and building strong engagement and trust with our customers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, prospect, and engage veterinary clinics across your territory and the wider UK as necessary
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline from initial outreach to close
  • Conduct product demonstrations and presentations (in-person and virtual)
  • Understand clinic operations and tailor solutions to customer needs
  • Develop long-term relationships with practice owners, managers, and clinical teams
  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets
  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM system
  • Gather market and customer feedback to inform product evolution and refine commercialisation strategy
  • Represent the company at veterinary events, conferences, and trade shows


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in B2B sales (veterinary sector preferred)
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently in a startup environment
  • Comfortable with outbound sales and consultative selling
  • Passion for sustainability and positive environmental impact
  • Willingness to travel within territory and further afield if necessary (Head office in the South West and industry events)
  • Full right to work in the United Kingdom

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to veterinary clinics
  • Familiarity with sustainability, waste reduction, or environmental compliance solutions
  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or high-growth company

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary (up to £40K) with performance-based commission
  • Car allowance
  • Share options
  • Opportunity to join an early-stage company and shape its growth
  • Meaningful work with real environmental impact
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Career progression as the company scales
